# landform

Topographic Position Index (TPI) based landform classification for R.

`landform` classifies a digital terrain model into slope-position
classes (valley, lower slope, flat, middle slope, upper slope, ridge) or
into ten landform classes (from canyons to mountain tops), following
Weiss (2001) and Jenness (2006). The TPI can be computed over square,
circular or annular neighbourhoods, sized in cells or in map units, and
standardised over the whole grid (as in the original method) or locally.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("landform")
```

## Example

``` r

library(landform)

dem <- malta_dtm()

# six-class Slope Position Classification, 9 x 9 cell window
sp <- landform(dem, scale = 9)
sp                  # class areas and percentages
plot(sp, shade = "slope")

# ten-class Landform Classification, circular neighbourhoods of 200 m and 1 km
lf <- landform(dem, class.type = "landform.classification",
               sn = 200, ln = 1000, units = "map", shape = "circle")
plot(lf, what = "area")
```

See the vignette,
[`vignette("landform")`](https://gianmarcoalberti.github.io/landform/articles/landform.md),
for a full walk-through.

## References

Jenness, J. (2006). Topographic Position Index (tpi_jen.avx) extension
for ArcView 3.x, v. 1.2. Jenness Enterprises.

Weiss, A. (2001). Topographic Position and Landforms Analysis. Poster
presentation, ESRI User Conference, San Diego, CA.

# Package index

## Classification

Classify a DTM into slope-position or landform classes; the result is an
object with print(), summary() and plot() methods.

- [`landform()`](https://gianmarcoalberti.github.io/landform/reference/landform.md)
  : Landform Classification
- [`plot(`*`<landform>`*`)`](https://gianmarcoalberti.github.io/landform/reference/plot.landform.md)
  : Plot a landform classification
- [`class_layers()`](https://gianmarcoalberti.github.io/landform/reference/class_layers.md)
  : One layer per class

## Topographic Position Index

The TPI surface on which the classifications are based.

- [`tpi()`](https://gianmarcoalberti.github.io/landform/reference/tpi.md)
  : Topographic Position Index

## Sample data

- [`malta_dtm()`](https://gianmarcoalberti.github.io/landform/reference/malta_dtm.md)
  : Sample digital terrain model of Malta
